title: Correction to: Activity, but not size of Black-tailed Praire Dog colonies, is associated with higher Athene cunicularia hypugaea (Western Burrowing Owl) occupancy and reproductive success in the shortgrass prairie
content: This is a correction to: Sarah R Albright, Reesa Y Conrey, William L Kendall, Activity, but not size of Black-tailed Prairie Dog colonies, is associated with higher Athene cunicularia hypugaea (Western Burrowing Owl) occupancy and reproductive success in the shortgrass prairie, Ornithological Applications, Volume 128, Issue 2, May 2026, Pages 1–12, https://doi.org/10.1093/ornithapp/duag027
